blocks.html: Welcome! This guide walks you through everything you need to know in a few minutes.

Download the package and follow these steps:

  1. Unzip the file.
  2. Upload it to your server.
  3. Open it in your browser.
Open the settings file and change the values you need. Tip: keep a copy of the original.
Write to support@example.com and we will get back to you.
